items.followUp: State two rules for deciding whether a zero in a measurement is significant.

rubric.why: This states the rule for all non-zero digits.
rubric.description: States that all non-zero digits are significant.

rubric.why: This gives a second rule for identifying significant digits.
rubric.description: States that zeros between non-zero digits are significant.

modelAnswer: All non-zero digits in a measurement are significant.
Zeros between non-zero digits are significant.

rubric.why: This gives the defining form of scientific notation.
rubric.description: Defines scientific notation as a number between 1 and 10 multiplied by a power of 10.

rubric.why: A correct example demonstrates the notation.
rubric.description: Gives a correct example of scientific notation.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for a valid example.

modelAnswer: Scientific notation expresses a number as a number between 1 and 10 multiplied by a power of 10.

items.followUp: Define static friction and kinetic friction.

rubric.why: This identifies friction as a force opposing relative motion or its tendency between contacting surfaces.
rubric.description: Defines friction as the force opposing relative motion, or its tendency, between surfaces in contact.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for the definition of friction.

rubric.why: Limiting friction is the maximum frictional force just before motion begins.
rubric.description: Defines limiting friction as the maximum friction just before a body starts moving.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for the definition of limiting friction.

modelAnswer: Friction is the force that opposes relative motion between surfaces in contact, or their tendency to move relative to one another.
Limiting friction is the maximum value of friction just before a body starts moving.

items.followUp: Where is the centre of gravity of a uniform circular disc?

rubric.why: The definition identifies the centre of gravity as a particular point of the body.
rubric.description: Identifies the centre of gravity as a point in the body.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying it as a point in the body.

rubric.why: The centre of gravity represents where the body's whole weight acts.
rubric.description: States that the body's whole weight is considered to act at this point.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for relating the point to the body's whole weight.

modelAnswer: The centre of gravity of a body is a point in the body.
The whole weight of the body is considered to act at this point.
